answer_1.quote: This paper attempts to improve the NLG evaluation benchmarks and make existing automatic metrics better reflect the actual quality of the hypotheses.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs in machine translation, summarization, and image captioning tasks using diversified references to improve evaluation reliability.
